numbering_rule_used: REG2-SPECIFIC numbering (unrelated to REG1's PARTIE/lettered/zone-code scheme): 'Annexe <roman numeral> :' -> level 1 (e.g. Annexe I, Annexe III, Annexe IX). '<ordinal> partie :' (French ordinals '1ère partie', '2ème partie') -> level 2, nested under whichever Annexe is currently open. Any unnumbered line is nested one level below whatever node is currently open on the stack (same generic fallback rule as REG1's UNNUMBERED_OTHER) — in this document that fires exactly once, for a stray descriptive paragraph under Annexe III that happens to end in a leader-dot run + page number (flagged separately in warnings, not trusted as real structure).
